jobs.name: Backend Checks
jobs.run: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy --config-file pyproject.toml

jobs.name: Backend Migration Drift
jobs.run: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run alembic check

jobs.name: Frontend Checks
jobs.run: cd frontend && pnpm lint && pnpm type-check && pnpm format:check && pnpm format:check:packages && pnpm build

jobs.name: Frontend Tests
jobs.run: cd frontend && pnpm test && STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 pnpm test:storybook && cd ../extension && pnpm test

skip.name: Security Scan (Trivy)
skip.reason: container/dep scan needs the Trivy action + registry access
